content.short: Atrix is a Solana-based automated market maker enabling swapping, staking, and liquidity provision with Serum integration, and developer support for Serum swaps, liquidity, and farming.
content.description: Atrix is a Solana-based automated market maker (AMM) that has amassed over $30 million in liquidity across nearly 200 vaults. It lets users swap assets, stake tokens, and contribute liquidity to pools, while providing access to the Serum DEX via Atrix’s interface. Developers can integrate Atrix into their applications to enable Serum-based swapping, add liquidity to Serum pools, and interact with farming contracts. Atrix works with and supports several Solana protocols, including Mango, Bonfida, and Slope.
